name: Priya Malhotra
text: Booked the monthly Standard package for my boutique. Reels quality is unreal and we gained 3k followers in the first month. The team plans everything — I just show up!

name: Rahul Verma
text: They covered my sister's birthday with the ₹5,000 package. Unlimited photos plus an edited reel that honestly looked like a movie trailer. Worth every rupee.

name: Sneha Iyer
text: Our café's product shots doubled online orders in two weeks. Moody, premium, exactly the vibe we asked for. Communication was crisp throughout.

name: Arjun Mehta
text: Premium reels for my fitness page — great hooks and editing. Slight delay on one delivery but they made up for it with a bonus reel. Recommended.

name: Kavitha Reddy
text: The growth meetings alone are worth the Premium package. Analytics, content calendar, everything handled. Finally social media feels like an asset, not a chore.

name: Vikram Singh Rathore
text: Shot our anniversary — candid moments captured beautifully, album delivered in 48 hours. True professionals with top-tier gear.
